name: agent
title: Agent transport
description: Reaches a channel through a local agent harness — how Gmail and Slack are read today.

connector.label: Connector
connector.hint: This is the CHANNEL, and half of every thread key. Required — an empty or unknown connector parks the source on config_error.

harness.label: Harness
harness.hint: The worker CLI that runs the fetch. Without a launchable one the source parks on config_error.

segments.label: Segments
segments.placeholder: INBOX — or channel IDs (C…) for slack
segments.hint: What to walk, one cursor each: mailboxes/labels for gmail (defaults to INBOX), channel IDs for slack (required — a channel id cannot be guessed).
